column1: #mapping_set_description: 'Groovy params.genomes map in an nf-core pipeline''s conf/igenomes.config (from the nf-core/tools pipeline template). One record per genome key; the key is the value users pass as --genome. Two syntaxes exist: a map literal (current template, rnaseq, sarek) and a nested config block (methylseq, atacseq, chipseq, AWS-iGenomes example config).'
